# Draft:Sharp Practice (wargame)

Sharp Practice is a tabletop wargame published by Too Fat Lardies in 2008, and 2016. It focuses on large-scale skirmishes in the black powder era (roughly 1700–1865), including periods such as the French and Indian War, American Revolutionary War, Napoleonic Wars, and American Civil War.
Gameplay
Sharp Practice uses a card-driven activation system. Players command forces of 30–120 figures.
The rules encourage, story-driven games inspired by literary heroes.
Reception
The game has been praised for its accessibility to historical wargamers, and lower model count compared to mass-battle systems. It received positive coverage in wargaming communities and is considered a key title from Too Fat Lardies.
